pack.title: Pick Your Color
pack.tagline: Each player chooses a color and tries to build the best set of nature photos.
pack.summary: Parent and kid each choose a color, then race gently to collect three strong nature photos in that color.

bonus_rules: Get a bonus if all three photos for one player are clearly different subjects.
Get a bonus if the parent and kid choose different colors.
rules.safety_note: Stay on public paths and sidewalks. Do not enter yards or private gardens.
rules.weather_note: Works best in neighborhoods with flowers, leaves, bark, painted curbs, or varied street trees nearby.

cards.title: Parent picks a color
cards.prompt: Choose one color before the walk starts.
cards.adult_prompt: Pick from red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, white, or pink.

cards.title: Kid picks a color
cards.prompt: Choose one color before the walk starts.
cards.adult_prompt: Help the child choose from the preset colors.

cards.title: Parent photo 1
cards.prompt: Take your first photo in your chosen color.

cards.title: Parent photo 2
cards.prompt: Take another photo in your chosen color.

cards.title: Parent photo 3
cards.prompt: Take a third photo in your chosen color.

cards.title: Kid photo 1
cards.prompt: Take your first photo in your chosen color.

cards.title: Kid photo 2
cards.prompt: Take another photo in your chosen color.

cards.title: Kid photo 3
cards.prompt: Take a third photo in your chosen color.

recap.title: Your color-vs-color recap
recap.success_message: Both players finished their color sets.
recap.partial_message: One color set is done. The other is close.
recap.empty_message: No color photos were saved this time.
highlight_rules: Show the parent color set side by side with the kid color set.
Call out whether the players chose the same or different colors.
